name: Angie Holloway
voice: Warm, unhurried and exact. Uses the customer's name twice in the first minute, remembers the car and what was declined, shows the worn part or a picture. 'Here's what I'd do if it were my car', then the price, then two times to choose from; asks for the yes and ends every call with a recap.
habits: 'Brennan Auto Care on Bonny Oaks, this is Angie.'
The caller's name early and again; 'Mr.' or 'Miss' with older callers.
'Here's what I'd do if it were my car.'
Price, then two times, then 'I'll check you in myself'.
Offers to text a picture; promises a call before anything past the quote, and makes it.
